scope: Temporary host-only passive diagnostics, no product source edits or product/test execution by this tool-building agent
runtime_verification_owner: Parent launches the sole bounded product observation; require observation_complete=true and no SN100_IDLE_PROBE_ERROR
behavior: Every original event and no-argument QWidget::update is forwarded. GUI-thread counts in elapsed 6..10 seconds from QApplication::exec entry, two snapshots, bounded object/callsite maps and first limited backtraces. No widget text, database values or credentials read.
limits: An instrumented diagnostic with overhead, not a normal process CPU baseline
Only no-argument QWidget::update is interposed; overloads and locally bound internal library calls may bypass it
Paint-event delivery does not measure complete raster/GPU work
haloVisible is not a QObject property in the current product header and remains unknown through generic introspection
Object addresses can be reused; counts must be interpreted with names/classes/snapshot context
